title: InclusiveShift-HAR: Auditable Wearable Activity Recognition under Population and Sensor-Interface Shift
description: Evidence-gated research software for participant-exclusive inertial human activity recognition. The package contains the locked InclusiveHAR benchmark, participant-level evaluation, RMRP/CTGR/HERA source-development methods, external sensor-interface diagnostics, and append-only records of corrections, negative outcomes and participant harms. InclusiveHAR trial boundaries remain unrecoverable. Later CTGR/HERA results are development evidence and do not establish clinical validity, state-of-the-art performance or independent superiority.
